<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="pt-BR">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Ivan Soluções Imobiliárias | O Seu Novo Lar Está Aqui</title>
    <meta name="description" content="A melhor imobiliária para encontrar casas, apartamentos e mansões de luxo com atendimento exclusivo.">
    
    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
    <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Montserrat:wght@300;400;500;600;800&family=Playfair+Display:ital,wght@0,400;0,600;0,700;1,400&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/font-awesome/6.4.0/css/all.min.css">

    <style>
        /* ==========================================================================
           1. VARIÁVEIS GERAIS E TEMAS (DESIGN SYSTEM)
           ========================================================================== */
        :root {
            --primary-color: #0d2b45;
            --primary-light: #1a4a75;
            --primary-dark: #07182b;
            --secondary-color: #d4af37; /* Dourado luxo */
            --secondary-hover: #f1c40f;
            --accent-color: #ff5722;
            --bg-light: #f4f7f6;
            --bg-white: #ffffff;
            --text-dark: #222222;
            --text-muted: #666666;
            --text-light: #ffffff;
            --glass-bg: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
            --glass-border: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
            --shadow-sm: 0 5px 15px rgba(0,0,0,0.05);
            --shadow-md: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
            --shadow-lg: 0 20px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.2);
            --shadow-gold: 0 10px 20px rgba(212,175,55,0.4);
            --transition-slow: all 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.8, 0.25, 1);
            --transition-med: all 0.5s ease;
            --transition-fast: all 0.3s ease;
            --font-main: 'Montserrat', sans-serif;
            --font-title: 'Playfair Display', serif;
            --border-radius-sm: 8px;
            --border-radius-md: 15px;
            --border-radius-lg: 20px;
            --border-radius-pill: 50px;
        }

        .dark-theme {
            --primary-color: #050b14;
            --primary-light: #0d1b2a;
            --primary-dark: #000000;
            --secondary-color: #f1c40f;
            --secondary-hover: #d4af37;
            --bg-light: #121212;
            --bg-white: #1e1e1e;
            --text-dark: #f0f0f0;
            --text-muted: #aaaaaa;
            --glass-bg: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
            --glass-border: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
            --shadow-sm: 0 5px 15px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
            --shadow-md: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
            --shadow-lg: 0 20px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.7);
        }

        /* ==========================================================================
           2. RESETS E CONFIGURAÇÕES GERAIS
           ========================================================================== */
        * {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            box-sizing: border-box;
            cursor: none;
        }

        html {
            scroll-behavior: smooth;
            overflow-x: hidden;
            font-size: 16px;
        }

        body {
            font-family: var(--font-main);
            background-color: var(--bg-light);
            color: var(--text-dark);
            overflow-x: hidden;
            transition: var(--transition-slow);
            line-height: 1.6;
        }

        ::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 12px; }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: var(--bg-light); }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { 
            background: var(--primary-light); 
            border-radius: 6px; 
            border: 3px solid var(--bg-light);
        }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover { background: var(--secondary-color); }

        /* ==========================================================================
           3. CURSOR CUSTOMIZADO MAGNÉTICO
           ========================================================================== */
        .custom-cursor {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0; left: 0;
            width: 20px; height: 20px;
            border: 2px solid var(--secondary-color);
            border-radius: 50%;
            pointer-events: none;
            z-index: 9999;
            transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
            transition: width 0.2s, height 0.2s, background-color 0.2s, border-color 0.2s;
            mix-blend-mode: difference;
        }
        .custom-cursor.hover {
            width: 60px; height: 60px;
            background-color: rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.4);
            border-color: transparent;
        }
        .custom-cursor.click {
            transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(0.8);
            background-color: var(--secondary-color);
        }

        /* ==========================================================================
           4. PRELOADER ANIMADO COMPLEXO
           ========================================================================== */
        #preloader {
            position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 100vh;
            background: var(--primary-dark);
            z-index: 10000;
            display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; flex-direction: column;
            transition: opacity 1s ease-out, visibility 1s ease-out, transform 1s ease-in-out;
        }
        .loader-logo-container { position: relative; margin-bottom: 30px; }
        .loader-logo {
            font-family: var(--font-title); color: var(--secondary-color);
            font-size: 4rem; letter-spacing: 3px; font-weight: 700;
            animation: pulseGlow 2s infinite alternate, floatUpDown 3s infinite ease-in-out;
            position: relative; z-index: 2;
        }
        .loader-ring {
            position: absolute; top: 50%; left: 50%;
            transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
            width: 150px; height: 150px;
            border: 2px solid transparent;
            border-top-color: var(--secondary-color);
            border-bottom-color: var(--secondary-color);
            border-radius: 50%;
            animation: spinRing 2s linear infinite;
            z-index: 1;
        }
        .loader-bar {
            width: 250px; height: 4px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
            border-radius: var(--border-radius-pill); overflow: hidden; position: relative;
        }
        .loader-progress {
            position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; height: 100%; width: 0%;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--secondary-color), #ffeb3b);
            animation: loadProgress 2.5s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) forwards;
        }
        .loader-text {
            color: var(--text-muted); margin-top: 15px; font-size: 0.9rem; letter-spacing: 2px;
            text-transform: uppercase; animation: blink 1.5s infinite;
        }

        /* ==========================================================================
           5. ANIMAÇÕES (KEYFRAMES)
           ========================================================================== */
        @keyframes pulseGlow {
            0% { text-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(212,175,55,0.2); transform: scale(1); }
            100% { text-shadow: 0 0 40px rgba(212,175,55,0.9); transform: scale(1.05); }
        }
        @keyframes spinRing { 0% { transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(0deg); } 100% { transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(360deg); } }
        @keyframes loadProgress { 0% { width: 0%; } 40% { width: 45%; } 80% { width: 80%; } 100% { width: 100%; } }
        @keyframes blink { 0%, 100% { opacity: 1; } 50% { opacity: 0.4; } }
        @keyframes fadeInUp { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(60px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } }
        @keyframes slideInLeft { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(-100px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(0); } }
        @keyframes slideInRight { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(100px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(0); } }
        @keyframes zoomIn { from { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.8); } to { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); } }
        @keyframes floatUpDown { 0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0px); } 50% { transform: translateY(-20px); } }
        @keyframes rotateGradient { 0% { background-position: 0% 50%; } 50% { background-position: 100% 50%; } 100% { background-position: 0% 50%; } }

        /* Classes Utilitárias de Scroll Reveal */
        .reveal { opacity: 0; visibility: hidden; }
        .reveal.active { animation: fadeInUp 1s cubic-bezier(0.5, 0, 0, 1) forwards; visibility: visible; }
        .reveal-left.active { animation: slideInLeft 1s cubic-bezier(0.5, 0, 0, 1) forwards; visibility: visible; }
        .reveal-right.active { animation: slideInRight 1s cubic-bezier(0.5, 0, 0, 1) forwards; visibility: visible; }
        .reveal-zoom.active { animation: zoomIn 1s cubic-bezier(0.5, 0, 0, 1) forwards; visibility: visible; }
        
        /* Delays para grids */
        .delay-100 { animation-delay: 0.1s; }
        .delay-200 { animation-delay: 0.2s; }
        .delay-300 { animation-delay: 0.3s; }
        .delay-400 { animation-delay: 0.4s; }

        /* ==========================================================================
           6. CABEÇALHO, NAVEGAÇÃO E MENU MOBILE
           ========================================================================== */
        header {
            position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; padding: 25px 5%;
            display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;
            z-index: 1000; transition: var(--transition-med); background: transparent;
        }
        header.scrolled {
            background: rgba(13, 43, 69, 0.95); backdrop-filter: blur(15px);
            padding: 15px 5%; box-shadow: var(--shadow-md); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
        }
        .logo { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 15px; text-decoration: none; position: relative; z-index: 1001; }
        .logo img { height: 45px; width: auto; object-fit: contain; transition: transform 0.3s; filter: drop-shadow(0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.5)); }
        .logo:hover img { transform: scale(1.1) rotate(-5deg); }
        .logo div { font-family: var(--font-title); font-size: 2.2rem; color: var(--text-light); font-weight: 700; text-shadow: 1px 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); }
        .logo span { color: var(--secondary-color); font-weight: 400; font-style: italic; }
        
        nav ul { display: flex; list-style: none; gap: 35px; }
        nav ul li a {
            color: var(--text-light); text-decoration: none; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.95rem;
            position: relative; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1.5px; padding: 10px 0;
            text-shadow: 1px 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
        }
        nav ul li a::before {
            content: ''; position: absolute; width: 100%; height: 2px; bottom: 0; left: 0;
            background-color: var(--secondary-color); transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: right; transition: transform 0.4s ease;
        }
        nav ul li a:hover::before { transform: scaleX(1); transform-origin: left; }
        
        .header-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 25px; z-index: 1001; }
        .theme-btn { background: none; border: none; color: var(--text-light); font-size: 1.4rem; transition: transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.68, -0.55, 0.265, 1.55); text-shadow: 1px 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); }
        .theme-btn:hover { transform: rotate(180deg) scale(1.3); color: var(--secondary-color); }
        
        .btn-glowing {
            padding: 12px 30px; background: linear-gradient(45deg, var(--secondary-color), #ffeb3b, var(--secondary-color)); background-size: 200% 200%;
            color: var(--primary-dark); font-weight: 800; border: none; border-radius: var(--border-radius-pill); text-decoration: none;
            text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1px; font-size: 0.9rem;
            animation: rotateGradient 4s ease infinite; box-shadow: var(--shadow-gold); transition: var(--transition-fast);
        }
        .btn-glowing:hover { box-shadow: 0 0 40px rgba(212, 175, 55, 1); transform: translateY(-5px); color: #000; }

        /* Menu Mobile Button */
        .mobile-toggle { display: none; background: transparent; border: none; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; z-index: 1001; }
        .mobile-toggle span { display: block; width: 35px; height: 3px; background: var(--secondary-color); transition: 0.4s; border-radius: 3px; }
        .mobile-toggle.active span:nth-child(1) { transform: translateY(9px) rotate(45deg); }
        .mobile-toggle.active span:nth-child(2) { opacity: 0; }
        .mobile-toggle.active span:nth-child(3) { transform: translateY(-9px) rotate(-45deg); }

        /* ==========================================================================
           7. HERO SECTION (PARTÍCULAS, PARALLAX, TYPING)
           ========================================================================== */
        .hero { position: relative; width: 100%; height: 100vh; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; overflow: hidden; }
        .hero-bg {
            position: absolute; top: -10%; left: -10%; width: 120%; height: 120%;
            background: url('https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1600596542815-ffad4c1539a9?ixlib=rb-4.0.3&auto=format&fit=crop&w=2500&q=80') center/cover no-repeat;
            z-index: 1; transform: translateZ(0); will-change: transform; filter: brightness(0.8);
        }
        .hero-overlay {
            position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(13,43,69,0.95) 0%, rgba(13,43,69,0.6) 50%, rgba(0,0,0,0.8) 100%); z-index: 2;
        }
        #particles-js { position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; z-index: 3; }
        
        .hero-content { position: relative; z-index: 4; text-align: center; color: var(--text-light); max-width: 900px; padding: 0 20px; }
        .hero-subtitle {
            display: inline-block; font-size: 1.1rem; letter-spacing: 6px; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--secondary-color);
            margin-bottom: 20px; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.3); padding: 5px 20px; border-radius: 20px; backdrop-filter: blur(5px); border: 1px solid rgba(212,175,55,0.3);
        }
        .hero-title { font-family: var(--font-title); font-size: 5.5rem; line-height: 1.1; margin-bottom: 25px; text-shadow: 2px 4px 15px rgba(0,0,0,0.8); font-weight: 700; }
        .typing-text { color: var(--secondary-color); border-bottom: 4px solid var(--secondary-color); }
        .typing-text::after { content: '|'; animation: blink 1s infinite; color: #fff; }
        .hero-desc { font-size: 1.3rem; font-weight: 300; opacity: 0.9; margin-bottom: 40px; text-shadow: 1px 1px 5px rgba(0,0,0,0.8); max-width: 700px; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto; }
        
        .hero-search {
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.15); backdrop-filter: blur(20px); padding: 15px; border-radius: var(--border-radius-pill);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.3); display: flex; gap: 15px; box-shadow: 0 20px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
            transform: translateY(0); transition: var(--transition-med);
        }
        .hero-search:hover { transform: translateY(-5px); box-shadow: 0 30px 50px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); border-color: var(--secondary-color); }
        .search-input-group { flex: 2; position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; }
        .search-input-group i { position: absolute; left: 20px; color: var(--primary-color); font-size: 1.2rem; z-index: 2; }
        .hero-search input, .hero-search select {
            width: 100%; padding: 18px 20px 18px 50px; border: none; border-radius: var(--border-radius-pill);
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.95); font-family: var(--font-main); font-size: 1rem; color: var(--text-dark); font-weight: 500; outline: none; transition: 0.3s;
        }
        .hero-search select { flex: 1; padding: 18px 20px; appearance: none; cursor: pointer; }
        .hero-search input:focus, .hero-search select:focus { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(212,175,55,0.5); }
        .hero-search button {
            padding: 15px 40px; border: none; border-radius: var(--border-radius-pill); background: var(--secondary-color);
            color: var(--primary-dark); font-weight: 800; font-size: 1.1rem; text-transform: uppercase; transition: var(--transition-fast); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
        }
        .hero-search button:hover { background: #fff; transform: scale(1.05); }

        .scroll-down {
            position: absolute; bottom: 40px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); z-index: 4;
            color: #fff; font-size: 2.5rem; animation: floatUpDown 2s infinite ease-in-out; opacity: 0.7; transition: 0.3s;
        }
        .scroll-down:hover { opacity: 1; color: var(--secondary-color); }

        /* ==========================================================================
           8. COMPONENTES REUTILIZÁVEIS
           ========================================================================== */
        .section-padding { padding: 120px 5%; }
        .section-title-wrapper { text-align: center; margin-bottom: 70px; }
        .section-subtitle { font-size: 1rem; color: var(--secondary-color); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 3px; font-weight: 700; display: block; margin-bottom: 10px; }
        .section-title {
            font-family: var(--font-title); font-size: 3.5rem; color: var(--primary-color); position: relative; display: inline-block;
        }
        .dark-theme .section-title { color: var(--text-dark); }
        .section-title::after {
            content: ''; position: absolute; bottom: -15px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%);
            width: 100px; height: 4px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--secondary-color), transparent); border-radius: 2px;
        }
        .text-center { text-align: center; }

        /* ==========================================================================
           9. SEÇÃO SOBRE A EMPRESA (IMAGENS SOBREPOSTAS E ESTATÍSTICAS)
           ========================================================================== */
        .about-section { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 60px; background: var(--bg-white); padding: 50px; border-radius: var(--border-radius-lg); box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm); }
        .dark-theme .about-section { background: var(--bg-white); }
        .about-images { flex: 1; position: relative; height: 650px; }
        .img-box { position: absolute; border-radius: var(--border-radius-md); overflow: hidden; box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg); transition: var(--transition-slow); }
        .img-box::after { content:''; position:absolute; top:0; left:0; width:100%; height:100%; background: linear-gradient(rgba(0,0,0,0), rgba(0,0,0,0.3)); pointer-events: none; }
        .img-box:hover { transform: scale(1.05) translateY(-10px); z-index: 10; box-shadow: 0 30px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.4); }
        .img-1 { width: 65%; height: 75%; top: 0; left: 0; z-index: 2; border: 5px solid var(--secondary-color); }
        .img-2 { width: 55%; height: 60%; bottom: 0; right: 0; z-index: 3; border: 12px solid var(--bg-white); }
        .img-box img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; transition: transform 1s ease; }
        .img-box:hover img { transform: scale(1.1); }
        
        .about-badge {
            position: absolute; top: 50%; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); z-index: 4;
            background: var(--primary-color); color: var(--secondary-color); width: 160px; height: 160px; border-radius: 50%;
            display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; align-items: center;
            border: 5px solid var(--bg-white); box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg); animation: pulseGlow 3s infinite alternate;
        }
        .about-badge h3 { font-size: 3rem; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1; }
        .about-badge p { font-size: 0.8rem; text-transform: uppercase; font-weight: 600; text-align: center; }

        .about-text { flex: 1; }
        .about-text .section-title { font-size: 3rem; margin-bottom: 30px; }
        .about-text .section-title::after { left: 0; transform: none; width: 80px; }
        .about-text p { margin-bottom: 25px; line-height: 1.8; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 1.15rem; }
        .about-features { list-style: none; margin-top: 30px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 15px; }
        .about-features li { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 15px; font-size: 1.05rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-dark); }
        .about-features i { color: var(--secondary-color); font-size: 1.3rem; background: rgba(212,175,55,0.1); padding: 10px; border-radius: 50%; }
        
        .stats-container { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 25px; margin-top: 50px; }
        .stat-item {
            text-align: center; padding: 30px 20px; background: var(--bg-light); border-radius: var(--border-radius-md);
            box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.05); transition: var(--transition-med); position: relative; overflow: hidden;
        }
        .dark-theme .stat-item { background: var(--primary-dark); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.05); }
        .stat-item::before {
            content:''; position: absolute; top:0; left:0; width: 4px; height: 100%; background: var(--secondary-color);
            transform: scaleY(0); transition: 0.4s; transform-origin: bottom;
        }
        .stat-item:hover::before { transform: scaleY(1); }
        .stat-item:hover { transform: translateY(-10px); box-shadow: var(--shadow-md); background: var(--bg-white); }
        .stat-number { font-size: 3rem; font-weight: 800; color: var(--primary-color); margin-bottom: 5px; font-family: var(--font-title); }
        .dark-theme .stat-number { color: var(--text-light); }
        .stat-label { font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--secondary-color); letter-spacing: 1px; }

        /* ==========================================================================
           10. VITRINE DE IMÓVEIS (FILTROS, CARDS 3D E MODAL)
           ========================================================================== */
        .properties-section { background-color: var(--primary-dark); color: var(--text-light); position: relative; }
        .properties-section .section-title { color: #fff; }
        
        .filter-tabs { display: flex; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 20px; margin-bottom: 60px; }
        .filter-btn {
            padding: 12px 35px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
            color: #fff; border-radius: var(--border-radius-pill); font-weight: 600; font-size: 1rem; letter-spacing: 1px;
            transition: var(--transition-fast); text-transform: uppercase;
        }
        .filter-btn.active, .filter-btn:hover { background: var(--secondary-color); border-color: var(--secondary-color); color: var(--primary-dark); transform: translateY(-3px); box-shadow: 0 10px 20px rgba(212,175,55,0.3); }

        .property-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(380px, 1fr)); gap: 40px; }
        
        .property-card {
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03); backdrop-filter: blur(10px); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
            border-radius: var(--border-radius-lg); overflow: hidden; position: relative; transform-style: preserve-3d; transition: all 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.8, 0.25, 1);
        }
        .property-card.hide { display: none; } /* Para o filtro */
        .property-card:hover { transform: translateY(-20px); box-shadow: 0 40px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.6); border-color: rgba(212,175,55,0.5); }
        
        .card-img { width: 100%; height: 280px; overflow: hidden; position: relative; }
        .card-img::after { content:''; position: absolute; bottom:0; left:0; width:100%; height:50%; background: linear-gradient(transparent, var(--primary-dark)); }
        .card-img img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; transition: transform 1s ease; }
        .property-card:hover .card-img img { transform: scale(1.15) rotate(2deg); }
        
        .tag-status {
            position: absolute; top: 20px; left: 20px; background: var(--secondary-color); color: var(--primary-dark);
            padding: 8px 20px; border-radius: var(--border-radius-pill); font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 800; text-transform: uppercase; z-index: 2; box-shadow: 0 5px 15px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
        }
        .tag-featured { position: absolute; top: 20px; right: 20px; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.6); color: #fff; padding: 10px; border-radius: 50%; z-index: 2; backdrop-filter: blur(5px); }
        .tag-featured i { color: var(--accent-color); }

            const canvas = document.getElementById('particles-js');

            canvas.height = window.innerHeight;

            let particlesArray = [];
            class Particle {
                constructor() {
                    this.x = Math.random() * canvas.width;
                    this.y = Math.random() * canvas.height;
                    this.size = Math.random() * 2 + 0.5;
                    this.speedX = Math.random() * 0.5 - 0.25;
                    this.speedY = Math.random() * 0.5 - 0.25;
                    this.opacity = Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.1;
                }
                update() {
                    this.x += this.speedX;
                    this.y += this.speedY;
                    if(this.x > canvas.width) this.x = 0;
                    if(this.x < 0) this.x = canvas.width;
                    if(this.y > canvas.height) this.y = 0;
                    if(this.y < 0) this.y = canvas.height;
                }
                draw() {
                    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(212, 175, 55, ${this.opacity})`;
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.arc(this.x, this.y, this.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                    ctx.fill();
                }
            }

            function initParticles() {
                particlesArray = [];
                let qtd = (canvas.width * canvas.height) / 10000;
                for(let i=0; i < qtd; i++) { particlesArray.push(new Particle()); }
            }
            function animateParticles() {
                ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
                for(let i=0; i < particlesArray.length; i++) {
                    particlesArray[i].update();
                    particlesArray[i].draw();
                }
                requestAnimationFrame(animateParticles);

    <script>
        // 1. Preloader
        window.addEventListener('load', () => {
            const preloader = document.getElementById('preloader');
            setTimeout(() => {
                preloader.style.opacity = '0';
                setTimeout(() => { preloader.style.visibility = 'hidden'; }, 1000);
            }, 2500); // Exibe a animação por um tempo extra
        });

        // 2. Ano dinâmico no footer
        document.getElementById('year').textContent = new Date().getFullYear();

        // 3. Cursor Customizado
        const cursor = document.getElementById('cursor');
        const hoverTargets = document.querySelectorAll('.hover-target');

        document.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
            cursor.style.left = e.clientX + 'px';
            cursor.style.top = e.clientY + 'px';
        });

        hoverTargets.forEach(target => {
            target.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => cursor.classList.add('hover'));
            target.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => cursor.classList.remove('hover'));
        });

        // 4. Efeito Sticky no Header
        const header = document.getElementById('header');
        window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
            if(window.scrollY > 50) {
                header.classList.add('scrolled');
            } else {
                header.classList.remove('scrolled');
            }
        });

        // 5. Scroll Reveal (Intersection Observer)
        const reveals = document.querySelectorAll('.reveal, .reveal-left');
        const revealOptions = { threshold: 0.15, rootMargin: "0px 0px -50px 0px" };

        const revealOnScroll = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries, observer) {
            entries.forEach(entry => {
                if(!entry.isIntersecting) return;
                entry.target.classList.add('active');
                
                // Dispara o contador quando a seção de estatísticas aparece
                if(entry.target.querySelector('#stats')) {
                    startCounters();
                }
                observer.unobserve(entry.target); // Anima apenas uma vez
            });
        }, revealOptions);

        reveals.forEach(el => revealOnScroll.observe(el));

        // 6. Contador Animado
        let countersStarted = false;
        function startCounters() {
            if(countersStarted) return;
            countersStarted = true;
            const counters = document.querySelectorAll('.stat-number');
            const speed = 200; // Quanto menor, mais rápido

            counters.forEach(counter => {
                const updateCount = () => {
                    const target = +counter.getAttribute('data-target');
                    const count = +counter.innerText;
                    const inc = target / speed;

                    if (count < target) {
                        counter.innerText = Math.ceil(count + inc);
                        setTimeout(updateCount, 15);
                    } else {
                        counter.innerText = target + (target > 1000 ? '+' : '%');
                    }
                };
                updateCount();
            });
        }

        // 7. Efeito de Digitação (Typing Effect)
        const texts = ["Viver com Luxo", "Fazer Excelentes Negócios", "Criar Memórias", "Encontrar Seu Lar"];
        let count = 0;
        let index = 0;
        let currentText = "";
        let letter = "";
        const typeTarget = document.getElementById('typing');

        (function type() {
            if(count === texts.length) { count = 0; }
            currentText = texts[count];
            letter = currentText.slice(0, ++index);
            typeTarget.textContent = letter;
            
            if(letter.length === currentText.length) {
                count++;
                index = 0;
                setTimeout(type, 2000); // Pausa quando termina a palavra
            } else {
                setTimeout(type, 100);
            }
        }());

        // 8. Efeito Parallax Simples no Hero Background
        const parallaxBg = document.getElementById('parallax-bg');
        window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
            let offset = window.scrollY;
            parallaxBg.style.transform = `translateY(${offset * 0.4}px)`;
        });

        // 9. Alternador de Tema (Dark/Light Mode)
        const themeBtn = document.getElementById('theme-toggle');
        const body = document.body;
        
        // Verifica preferência salva
        if(localStorage.getItem('theme') === 'dark') {
            body.classList.add('dark-theme');
            themeBtn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-sun"></i>';
        }

        themeBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
            body.classList.toggle('dark-theme');
            if(body.classList.contains('dark-theme')) {
                themeBtn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-sun"></i>';
                localStorage.setItem('theme', 'dark');
            } else {
                themeBtn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-moon"></i>';
                localStorage.setItem('theme', 'light');
            }
        });

        // 10. Carousel de Depoimentos
        let slideIndex = 0;
        const track = document.getElementById('testi-track');
        const dots = document.querySelectorAll('.dot');
        
        function changeSlide(n) {
            slideIndex = n;
            track.style.transform = `translateX(-${slideIndex * 100}%)`;
            dots.forEach(dot => dot.classList.remove('active'));
            dots[slideIndex].classList.add('active');
        }

        setInterval(() => {
            slideIndex = (slideIndex + 1) % dots.length;
            changeSlide(slideIndex);
        }, 5000);

        // 11. Sistema de Partículas (Canvas Simples para Background)
        const canvas = document.getElementById('particles-js');
        const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
        canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
        canvas.height = window.innerHeight;

        let particlesArray;

        class Particle {
            constructor(x, y, directionX, directionY, size, color) {
                this.x = x;
                this.y = y;
                this.directionX = directionX;
                this.directionY = directionY;
                this.size = size;
                this.color = color;
            }
            draw() {
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(this.x, this.y, this.size, 0, Math.PI * 2, false);
                ctx.fillStyle = this.color;
                ctx.fill();
            }
            update() {
                if (this.x > canvas.width || this.x < 0) this.directionX = -this.directionX;
                if (this.y > canvas.height || this.y < 0) this.directionY = -this.directionY;
                this.x += this.directionX;
                this.y += this.directionY;
                this.draw();
            }
        }

        function initParticles() {
            particlesArray = [];
            let numberOfParticles = (canvas.height * canvas.width) / 15000;
            for (let i = 0; i < numberOfParticles; i++) {
                let size = (Math.random() * 2) + 1;
                let x = (Math.random() * ((innerWidth - size * 2) - (size * 2)) + size * 2);
                let y = (Math.random() * ((innerHeight - size * 2) - (size * 2)) + size * 2);
                let directionX = (Math.random() * 0.4) - 0.2;
                let directionY = (Math.random() * 0.4) - 0.2;
                let color = 'rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.4)'; // Dourado das partículas
                particlesArray.push(new Particle(x, y, directionX, directionY, size, color));
            }
        }

        function animateParticles() {
            requestAnimationFrame(animateParticles);
            ctx.clearRect(0, 0, innerWidth, innerHeight);
            for (let i = 0; i < particlesArray.length; i++) {
                particlesArray[i].update();
            }
        }

        window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
            canvas.width = innerWidth;
            canvas.height = innerHeight;
            initParticles();
        });

        initParticles();
        animateParticles();

    </script>
